title: Laboratory Review Visits — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment, standing referrals: laboratory review visits — points of judgement.**

**The rule.** Laboratory review visits are added to a standing referral's allowance, before the standing-referral visit ceiling is applied. They are counted as the member's paid lab and x-ray claims — claims in the lab and x-ray category booked on the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership** — with a service date in the monitoring window of **3 months**: **3 or more** claims add the larger laboratory allowance of **4** visits, **1 or 2** claims add the smaller laboratory allowance of **2** visits, and no claim adds nothing.

**Point 1 — the window.** The monitoring window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a claim is inside it when fewer than 3 whole months separate its service date from the handling date, so a claim dated exactly 3 months back is outside it.

**Point 2 — which claims.** Only paid claims in the lab and x-ray category count; other claim categories and unpaid claims do not.

**Point 3 — the bands.**

| Paid lab and x-ray claims in the last 3 months | Laboratory review visits added |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 or 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 4 |

**Point 4 — worked cases (hypothetical, handling date 15 September 2026).**

- Paid lab and x-ray claims on 1 July, 22 July and 2 September 2026: three, so 4 visits.
- Paid lab and x-ray claims on 15 June and 2 September 2026: 15 June is exactly 3 months back and outside; one claim, so 2 visits.
- No paid lab and x-ray claim since 15 June 2026: no laboratory review visit.
